selection_scope: seen-class samples only; activity-stratified fitting/validation split; no unseen sensor samples, unseen labels, or downstream chain results
constant_attribute_policy: place constants last in forward before reversal
forward_definition: descending weighted priority from seen-only Logistic Regression validation; ties follow each split's A2 schema order
reverse_definition: exact reversal of the split-specific Logistic Regression forward order
